rationale: Nine independent offline scenarios establish schema/attribution/temporal/review invariants, not empirical model accuracy. Recommended 75% impact; 75% weaken/contradict; 90% attribution; 10% unsupported relation/quote maximum and 100% schema. No threshold tuning. Balanced held-out synthetic set constructed and first used only after prompt freeze. Independent templates are never used for prompt tuning.
resourceRule: zero real development/smoke; exactly one locked impact-only benchmark; frozen qwen3.5:9b; no acquisition/ranking/embedding calls
